postHocSensitivity.rule: Exclude predictions whose itemType is Jewelry, which has no Fashionpedia main category. This was chosen after inspecting mismatches and is not the primary score; original labels and predictions remain unchanged.

interpretationLimits: Single mode is designed for one item; this is a workflow comparison, not a fair contest between equal-capacity detectors.
Multiple uses high image detail, 4096 output tokens and a six-detection cap; single uses low detail and 1200 tokens.
No manual ground-truth corrections were made after predictions.
Failure codes identify pipeline rejection classes, not necessarily a unique root cause; failed raw outputs were not retained.
Category-set recall is not per-garment detection accuracy or user acceptance.
Public data may have been seen during model training; only two hat images.

Jewelry is supported by the app but absent from the dataset main-category ontology; visible unlabeled bottoms were also found during diagnostic review. Extra labels are disagreements with annotations, not necessarily hallucinations.
